topic: bound XLSX decompression before materializing the workbook
lesson: The 15MB upload cap only limits the COMPRESSED xlsx; exceljs Workbook.xlsx.load decompresses + parses the whole ZIP into memory BEFORE the 25,000-row check, a zip-bomb/DoS vector. Bound the DECOMPRESSED size (cap total uncompressed bytes / entry count while reading, or stream with a hard ceiling) and enforce the row cap as early as possible - fail fast before full materialization.
